opening.argument: The offer is a conventional retail promotion: viewers are told they can receive a $25 Target gift card by purchasing at least $100 of specified baby products, with additional coupons available to reduce the cost. The description expressly limits the reward to buying “$100 worth of Diapers, Training Pants, Baby Wipes and/or Formula!” and invites viewers to “check out all of the great coupons that you can stack.” The requested conduct is an ordinary qualifying purchase and coupon use, not payment to an unknown party, disclosure of credentials, or submission of sensitive information. The historical offer's activation or fulfillment is not established.
